Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP for respondent No.1.
Respondent No.2 is served and has remained unrepresented before this Court.

3. FIR in Crime No.9/2024 was registered by Kibbanhalli Police Station, Tumakuru for the aforesaid offences against the petitioner herein based on the first information dated 11.02.2024 received from the victim girl aged about 17 years.
During the course of investigation, petitioner herein was arrested on 12.02.2024 and subsequently, remanded to judicial custody.

After completing investigation,
charge sheet has been filed against the accused persons who are now being tried before the trial Court in Spl.C.No.240/2024.
Petitioner's bail application filed before the trial Court in Crl.Misc.No.478/2025 was rejected on 21.04.2025.
Therefore, he is before this Court.

sentences.text: Perusal of the material on record would go to show that the petitioner and the victim girl were acquainted for a period of nearly two years.
The allegation against the petitioner is that he had proposed to the victim girl and though she had rejected his proposal, he was pestering her to love him.

She has stated that petitioner had come to her house when she was NC: 2025:KHC:24946 HC-KAR alone and had sexual intercourse with her against her wishes and thereafter had criminally intimidated her stating that her photos and videos will be updated in social media.
Petitioner, who has no criminal antecedents, is in custody for the last nearly seventeen months.

Before the trial Court, the victim girl has already been examined as PW.1, therefore, there cannot be any apprehension that petitioner may tamper with the material charge sheet witness in the event he is enlarged on bail.
Out of the 29 charge sheet witnesses cited in the present case, till date only one charge sheet witness has been examined before the trial Court.
Therefore, the chances of the trial being completed and the case being disposed of on merits in the near soon is remote.

Under the circumstances, I am of the view that, without expressing any opinion on the merits or demerits of the case, solely on the ground of petitioner's incarceration, his prayer for grant of bail needs to be answered affirmatively.
5. Accordingly, the following;
( i) The petition is allowed.
